youtube.baslik: In surgery, how does the surgeon measure the reflex the implant triggers? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The electrically evoked stapedial reflex threshold (ESRT) is the level at which the stapedius muscle contracts to electrical stimulation from the implant; the signal passes through the reflex arc in the brainstem to the facial nerve. In surgery, the surgeon watches the stapedius tendon or stapes through the microscope and reports the level at which contraction appears as current is raised; this value is often close to, or slightly above, the highest comfort level.
